claim_scope: new project-level equation-to-complete-nef realization of a known K3 chamber and known abstract finite-volume Coxeter polytope

complete_nef_handoff.transport_argument: for NS isometric to U+E8(-1)^2, the nef cone is a Weyl chamber in the positive cone; Weyl transport identifies it with the published complete 19-wall chamber

lineage.priority_boundary: neither the Inose equation nor Vinberg's H17/19 chamber is claimed new worldwide; their explicit algebraic matching is the positive realization added here
lineage.published_projective_model: Double cover of P2 branched over a sextic with an A17 singularity; the wall graph is the classical Vinberg graph

generic_exactness.finite_equivalences: an ordered-II*-fibration isomorphism has t->lambda*t; comparison of the monic palindromic R gives lambda^4=1 and generically lambda^2=1, hence only B->+/-B and the finite cube-root ambiguity in A; swapping 0 and infinity adds only another finite identification
generic_exactness.forgetful_map: on a fixed K3, elliptic fibrations and sections are integral divisor classes, so forgetting the marked fibration has zero-dimensional fibers
generic_exactness.period_argument: the L-polarized K3 period domain for rank(L)=18 has dimension two; the family has two-dimensional image. The rho>=19 Noether--Lefschetz locus is a countable union of proper curves, so the very general member has rho=18
generic_exactness.scope: exact for the geometric very general member; (A,B)=(1,3) only witnesses the open and is not asserted to have geometric Picard rank 18

neron_severi.trivial_lattice_argument: fiber, zero section, and the nonidentity components of the two II* fibers give U+E8(-1)^2
neron_severi.unimodular_closure: the displayed determinant-one lattice is primitive and has no proper integral same-rank overlattice; after rho=18 it is the whole NS, and Shioda--Tate forces Mordell--Weil rank and torsion zero
